R8503.summary: Sir Edward Stafford at Paris to Walsingham, 19 September 1586, a clear despatch on Mary Queen of Scots, Mendoza and Charles Paget; the four cipher runs name Villequier, the King of Navarre, the plan to kill him and the Prince of Condé, and the Duke of Guise's guard.

system: Graphic-sign and letter-form alphabet with homophones and a null, plus two-digit codes for persons (47 King of Navarre, 59 Prince of Conde, 74 Duke of Guise).
